items.name: spec_compliance
items.note: Read-only GET /tasks/:id/session-file: project root via path-guard+realpath, outside only with session evidence (Output, chat, tool call), size cap, MIME allowlist, NUL sniff, no listing, symlink escapes rejected, stateless bounded scan, docs token.

items.name: error_handling
items.note: Typed 400/403/404/413/415/500 answers; unreadable session or scan timeout fails closed (incomplete); queue survives rejections.

items.name: security_basics
items.note: Evidence before realpath, single resolution for project check, handle-based single open, UNC/foreign drive rejected, credential denylist, no cwd root; residuals recorded (replaced file, hardlink, quoted spaces).

items.name: test_quality
items.note: 62 tests with real temp dirs/junctions and synthetic JSONL: traversal, symlink, unevidenced, each evidence source, tool_result/meta/bash output excluded, boundaries, sensitive names, 413/415, session binding, Windows case.

items.name: performance_basics
items.note: Serialized scans with 20s timeout, prefilter by basename, positional newest-48MB window; no memo (documented).

items.name: naming_structure
items.note: core/session-file/{access,evidence,safe-read,sensitive}, external/session-file/routes; all files under 300 lines; routes.ts bloat baseline unchanged (mount via session-info router).

items.name: affected_boundaries
items.note: Boundary = session JSONL (producer Claude, consumer evidence scan) round-tripped with synthetic JSONL incl. CRLF, BOM, non-ASCII; filesystem boundary probed with real junctions.
